title: zanthoxylum chevalieri
intro: Zanthoxylum chevalieri, commonly known as the Chevalier's Prickly Ash, is a species of plant in the family Rutaceae. It is a deciduous shrub or small tree native to China, and has been used in traditional medicine for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Zanthoxylum chevalieri include its anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antifungal properties, which may help to alleviate symptoms of fever, cough, and sore throat. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions such as analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant effects.
